extracted.name: Starr’s Savory Meatballs
extracted.description: Starr’s savory meatball recipe combines ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, Parmesan cheese, Worcestershire sauce, and three herbs — thyme, oregano, basil.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup dry bread crumbs, or as needed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

Mix ground beef, onion, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, eggs, garlic, oregano, basil, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl until just combined. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions; roll each portion into 4 meatballs. Arrange meatballs on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the centers, 15 to 20 minutes.
